# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, emotionless young man with a round, freckle-covered face. His appearance is characterised by a broad, expressionless or endlessly grinning face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Barney is exceedingly bashful, timid, and quiet, possessing very little capacity for chatter or laughter. He is an earnest, hard-working, and reliable man without negative vices, though he lacks conversational skills and ambition.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v4 c36 P7](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0007)_

## Traits

- Bashful  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Timid  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney drove a double-seated buggy to carry Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke to a concert in Pale Sands, feeling immense pride in traveling alongside Nell, for whom he harbored deep admiration. After his father bestowed the upper farm upon him, Barney wished to marry Nell, but his extreme bashfulness led him to persuade his sister Odette to propose on his behalf. Following Nell's firm refusal, he turned his affections toward Nettie Scobie and married her later that year. The newlyweds were witnessed entering the Gorham Pullen church pew in high spirits on their 'appearing out' Sunday.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

- Given ownership of the upper farm by his father  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
